note: Window: 8 quarterly equity calls Q1 FY27 back to Q2 FY25, all held and opened. Separate fixed-income/debt calls exist for Q4 FY26 (and possibly other quarters); these were used only as outcome evidence, not as promise sources. Override test (backbone §4 SEVERE: could permanently impair capital, end a revenue stream, or make reported numbers unreliable) was applied to every contradicted class-10 assurance. Each one concerned Khavda evacuation or curtailment, at about 5-14% of generation or EBITDA, and none met the test, so no call was forced to 0. Page numbers follow the 'N | P a g e' or 'Page X of Y' headers. The Q1 FY26 PDF carries no page headers, so the speaker and section are cited instead. Quotes come from WebFetch extraction of the filed PDFs and are excerpts; the transcripts carry the company's transcription-error disclaimer.
